_about: Sample manual fingering override (Henle-style teacher's answer key) for Canon in D RH first 12 onsets. Mirrors eval_data/canon_rh_gt.json's manually-curated fingerings. NOT auto-applied — see _activation below.
_activation: To activate: copy this file (or symlink) next to the target MIDI as '<midi_basename>_fingering.json'. e.g. cp songs/canon_henle_fingering.json 'input_songs/Canon In D - Pachelbel  EASY Piano Tutorial_fingering.json'. Then run any pipeline (--fingering arlstm or pianoplayer or biomech) and the override will take precedence over the algorithmic decision for the matching (time, pitch) entries.
_source: eval_data/canon_rh_gt.json (12 user-curated entries from Stage A initial GT)
